subject: Encryption & Key Management — follow-up and next steps
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@medsentry.com>
Cc: Mark Rivera <mark.rivera@medsentry.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Encryption & Key Management — follow-up and next steps

Hi Claire / Mark,

Thanks again for taking the demo today — appreciate the candid discussion about PHI scope and the compliance timeline. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary from my side:
- Compliance: You indicated HIPAA is a hard requirement and SOC 2 Type II is in your procurement checklist.
- Keys: You prefer customer-managed keys (BYOK) for any workload that touches PHI. HSM-backed keys were listed as "preferred" in the call.
- Auditability: You need key rotation windows and per-key access/audit logs retained for at least 12 months.
- Residency: Data will live in us‑west‑2 for the initial rollout.

Attachments: I attached a short note with KMS options that map to those preferences (redwood_kms_options.pdf).

Questions we had for you (so we can scope the right integration):
1) Will MediSentry require an on-prem HSM (FIPS 140‑2 level) or are cloud HSMs (AWS CloudHSM / Azure Dedicated HSM) acceptable?
2) Do you need the private key material to never leave your control (true BYOK exportable key material), or is envelope‑encryption where you control the root key sufficient?
3) Any contractual language around key rotation frequency or key retention beyond 12 months?

Proposed next steps:
- Claire/Mark: reply here with answers to the three short questions above and attach the vendor security questionnaire if you want us to start filling it in.
- Stephanie: loop in our security/crypto SME for technical details and SOC 2 evidence (I will do that after your reply).
- If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute technical deep dive with our security engineer next week.

Thanks — looking forward to your replies.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood_kms_options.pdf (summary of managed vs BYOK options)
From: Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@medsentry.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Rivera <mark.rivera@medsentry.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Encryption & Key Management — follow-up and next steps

Stephanie, thanks for the clear recap and the PDF — that helped. Quick answers below, and attaching our KMS questionnaire (MediSentry_KMS_QS.docx) for you to start; we usually use that as the canonical intake.

Answers to your three Qs:
1) Cloud HSMs are acceptable (AWS CloudHSM or Azure Dedicated HSM). On‑prem HSM is not required for this phase.
2) We require that the root/master key material remains under our control and be managed via our cloud KMS tenant. Envelope encryption where we provide the CMK is acceptable — that covers our BYOK requirement.
3) Rotation: contractual requirement is annual rotation for master keys and the ability to perform emergency rotation. Retention: audit logs must be retained for a minimum of 12 months; if you have longer default retention, that is fine.

Other notes:
- Scope: PHI lives in a finite subset of stores (patient records and attachments). We'll share a sanitized inventory once NDA is in place.
- SOC2: we will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and an internal security point of contact to accelerate procurement.

Can you confirm you can support: BYOK via customer KMS tenant (we'll provide the CMKs), HSM backing via CloudHSM, per-key audit logs and 12+ months retention, and the ability to rotate keys on demand?

If yes, please loop in your security lead and we can set up the technical session.

Thanks,
Claire Thompson
Sr. Security Ops Manager | MediSentry Health
claire.thompson@medsentry.com

Attachment: MediSentry_KMS_QS.docx

I attached their questionnaire; they asked us to start filling it out. Would you prefer I share that directly with security ops or do you want to own the intake?

Thanks — Claire is available for a technical deep dive next week if needed.

—Stephanie

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MediSentry — KMS/BYOK requirements (please advise)

Stephanie / Karthik,

Thanks for the summary — we can support MediSentry's ask with the following notes (high-level answers you can share with the customer; happy to join the technical call):

1) BYOK model: supported. We support envelope encryption where customer supplies the CMK in their cloud KMS tenant (AWS KMS or Azure Key Vault). Redwood will store only wrapped DEKs. Customers keep control of the root key and can revoke/unconfigure keys from their tenant if needed.

2) HSM-backed CMKs: supported via AWS CloudHSM or Azure Dedicated HSM, both are compatible with our envelope workflows. If MediSentry wants an on‑prem HSM integration later, we can discuss a custom connector but that is out of band for early pilots.

3) Key rotation: we support customer-triggered rotation and automated rotation workflows. Emergency rotation can be executed (we'll coordinate cutover windows). We recommend yearly rotation for master keys; application DEKs can be rotated more frequently.

4) Audit logs and retention: we maintain per‑request cryptographic audit logs (access events, key ops) and can export logs to a customer S3 bucket or shared log sink. Default retention is 365 days; we can support longer retention on request (pricing/retention SLA to be scoped).

5) Data in transit / at rest: TLS 1.3 for in‑transit, AES‑GCM 256 for at‑rest by default. We support customer-supplied encryption schemes via the envelope model if they have a mandated cipher.

6) SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type II report for our production platform (attached). We can sign an NDA / DPA and provide the report via a secure link or gated DocuSign hub for procurement.

Action items:
- Karthik: can you own the questionnaire intake and fill the vendor KMS sections with our standard answers? If you'd like, I can provide the more technical snippets.
- Stephanie: please share the HubSpot deal id (MED-4827) and loop procurement on next steps; copy me on any request for SOC2 share.

I'll attach the SOC2 file to this thread for procurement.

-Rishi

Attachment: soc2-type2-2027.pdf
